Sourced from czlonkowski/Zie619 n8n-workflows community archive (workflows/Gmail/0544_Gmail_GoogleDrive_Create_Triggered.json). Configure credentials and any hardcoded IDs before activating.

**Difficulty**: auto-deploy

**Setup**:
1. Configure credentials for the services above
2. Update any hardcoded IDs / URLs
3. Test with sample data before activating
